description.text: The major is designed to train professionals with modern management knowledge and methods, communication science, who have knowledge and capabilities of management, economics, law and business management. Graduates are qualified for such position as management, teaching and research in various institutions and government departments. Business Management was set up in 1987with its first batch of students (before 1998 it was named Management, and after 1998 it was renamed Business Management). As professional advantages, it is based on telecommunications industry to set up professional training objectives and personnel training requirements. It takes management science as the main body winged by economics and information technology, aiming to nurture student in corporate management, economics and law so that they can be expertise in the industrial and commercial enterprises, government departments, utilities units (especially the telecommunications industry) to adapt to the current economic globalization on the demand for management talent. Students in the first two years are trained in accordance with the discipline Business Administration for a solid theoretical basis. At the third school year they are to finish the follow-up professional courses in accordance with their own choice of specialties.

duration.text: The Business Administration at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
